reading.body:
Melva Wallace is President and CEO of Huston-Tillotson University, a historically Black university in Austin, Texas.

The record contains only her current leadership role, classified under Advocates and Public Voices with a field of higher education administration. It includes no AI-specific activity, statement, project, or date beyond the present position.

This data does not establish any connection between Wallace or the university and AI compute, data center buildings, or grid power. It shows only that a higher education leader in Austin is catalogued as a potential public voice, without evidence of what she advocates or how it relates to AI.
